title: Yellow Dense Japanese Saskatoon Berries Yakitori
description: A bitter and dense one-pot Japanese dish featuring Saskatoon berries, double-fry KFC method, and vegan-friendly ingredients, formed into yakitori style.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, mix together the flour, cornstarch, and KFC seasoning.
Dip each Saskatoon berry into the flour mixture, then into the hot oil for 2-3 minutes, until lightly browned.
Remove the berries from the oil and let cool for 5 minutes.
Double-fry the berries by dipping them into the flour mixture again and then into the hot oil for an additional 2 minutes, until crispy.
In a small bowl, whisk together the rice vinegar and sesame oil.
Add the yellow food coloring to the vinegar mixture and stir well.
Brush the vinegar mixture onto the double-fried berries.
Thread 2-3 berries onto each bamboo skewer.
Serve the yakitori hot, garnished with additional sesame oil and rice vinegar if desired.
